sloka: न ते सम्भाषितुम् शक्याः सम्प्रश्नोऽत्र न विद्यते ।प्रकृत्या कोपनास्तीक्षिणा वानरा राक्षसाधिप ॥६-२४-३०॥।।
transliteration: na te sambhāṣitum śakyāḥ sampraśno'tra na vidyate ।prakṛtyā kopanāstīkṣiṇā vānarā rākṣasādhipa ॥6-24-30॥।।

translations.english: "O king of Rakshasas! It was not possible to negotiate there with the Vanaras). I had no opportunity to interrogate with them. By nature, Vanaras are violent and are highly furious."
